name: 62471 · Vandalia, IL
findings: ZIP 62471 (Vandalia) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62471 (Vandalia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62471 (Vandalia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.
